title: 实验室废物的分类与处置
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/03_Module 10 — Waste Management.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/03_Module 10 — Waste Management/src.py

points.K1: 废物管理是安全的一环
points.K3: 从产生到销毁，全程追踪
points.K18: 从源头到终点都经得起查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排颜色不同的废液桶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of waste containers in different colors with blank labels and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室废物怎么分类处置。
overlay: 实验室废物的分类与处置

shots.scene: 追踪箭头、分类桶、标签、生物危害、运输车五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a tracking arrow, sorting bins, a blank label, a biohazard symbol and a delivery truck. No people.
shots.narration: 追踪、分类、暂存、生物废物、转运。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一瓶用剩的废液，走向一只废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Wearing goggles and gloves, the young male student carries a small bottle of leftover waste liquid toward a waste container.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，想顺手倒掉废液。

shots.scene: 废液桶上的空白标签特写，阿杰没有看
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank label on the waste container while the young male student looks away, not reading it.
shots.narration: 他没看桶上的标签。

shots.scene: 小研快步上前拦住他，指着标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly steps in, stops him and points at the container label.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：先看清这是哪类废液！

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 倒错一次，就可能起火。

shots.section_title: 废物管理是安全的一环
shots.scene: 实验台旁几只分类废物桶，整齐排列
shots.prompt_en: A neat row of sorted waste bins and containers beside a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 实验总会产生废物。
overlay: 废物管理是安全的一环

shots.section_title: 废物管理是安全的一环
shots.scene: 分类、标签、暂存、处置四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: sorting bins, a blank label, a storage shelf and a disposal truck. No people.
shots.narration: 分好、标好、存好、送走，一步不能少。

shots.scene: 通风橱里冒出火焰的图标，旁边一个钱袋
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood with flames, next to a money bag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一次可预防的通风橱火灾，损失20万美元。

shots.scene: 实验室门上挂着停用牌，日历翻过两页
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with a blank closed sign hanging on it while calendar pages flip by. No people.
shots.narration: 所有实验还停摆了两周。

shots.section_title: 从产生到销毁，全程追踪
shots.scene: 一条长箭头从实验台连到焚烧炉图标
shots.prompt_en: A long arrow running from a lab bench icon to an incinerator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按美国资源保护与回收法，全程追踪。
overlay: 从产生到销毁，全程追踪

shots.section_title: 从产生到销毁，全程追踪
shots.scene: 小研在空白废物登记本上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes an entry in a blank waste logbook beside a waste container.
shots.narration: 每一桶都要有记录。

shots.scene: 一大一小两堆废物桶图标，旁边是秤
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small pile and a large pile of waste containers, next to a weighing scale. No people.
shots.narration: 每月100到1000千克，算小量产生者。

shots.scene: 老周翻看空白月度统计表
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews a blank monthly waste statistics sheet at his desk.
shots.narration: 一个月超千克上限，升为大量，限90天。

shots.scene: 放大镜对着一只废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass held over a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么判断是不是危险废物？

shots.scene: 一本空白名录书，手指点在一行上
shots.prompt_en: A blank directory book with a finger pointing at one line. No people.
shots.narration: 一看是否被名录点名，如废溶剂。

shots.scene: 易燃、腐蚀、反应、毒性四个危险象形图标
shots.prompt_en: Four hazard pictograms in a row: flammable flame, corrosive, exploding bomb for reactive, and skull for toxic. No people.
shots.narration: 二看是否易燃、腐蚀、反应或有毒。

shots.scene: 王老师对小研说话，手里拿着空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks with the female graduate student while holding a blank safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 拿不准，按危险废物处理并请教。

shots.scene: 两只废液桶之间画着红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two waste containers with a big red X between them. No people.
shots.narration: 不相容的废液，混在一起会出大事。

shots.scene: 酸的图标和含氰废液图标相碰，冒出骷髅云，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An acid icon meeting a cyanide waste icon, producing a skull cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碰含氰废液，会放出剧毒气体。

shots.scene: 酸和碱图标相碰，冒出热浪，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An acid icon meeting a base icon with heat waves bubbling over, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碰碱，剧烈放热会沸溢。

shots.scene: 氧化剂和易燃物图标相碰，冒出火焰，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An oxidizer pictogram meeting a flammable pictogram with flames, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化剂碰易燃物，会着火。

shots.scene: 活泼物质与卤代废液图标相碰，出现爆炸图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A reactive substance icon meeting a halogenated waste icon with an explosion symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有些组合还会爆炸。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一张空白相容性表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank compatibility chart on a board.
shots.narration: 多数废物事故，都是混错了。

shots.scene: 一个酸瓶图标被倒进有机溶剂桶图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an acid bottle being poured into an organic solvent waste container, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人把少量硝酸倒进溶剂桶。

shots.scene: 废液桶图标慢慢变红，两小时后冒出火苗
shots.prompt_en: A waste container icon slowly turning red with a clock showing hours passing, then a small flame appears. No people.
shots.narration: 持续自热约两小时，然后起火。

shots.scene: 标签是对的，眼睛图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A correct blank label next to a closed eye icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 标签没错，只是没人看。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下来，认真看桶上的标签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses and carefully reads the label on the waste container before pouring.
shots.narration: 每次倒之前，都读一遍标签。

shots.scene: 通风橱旁一块划出的暂存区域，放着几只废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A marked waste accumulation area next to a fume hood with a few closed waste containers in a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 废液先放在产生点旁的暂存区。

shots.scene: 小研站在暂存区旁，看着桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands next to the accumulation area, keeping an eye on the containers.
shots.narration: 由使用的人直接看管。

shots.scene: 暂存区里的桶堆得过高，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An accumulation area with containers stacked too high, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危废上限55加仑，急性危废1夸脱。

shots.scene: 台面上放着一只大小合适的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A waste container of suitable small size on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 按上限选用合适大小的桶。

shots.scene: 装满的废液桶旁一个倒计时钟
shots.prompt_en: A full waste container next to a countdown clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 到了上限，3天内必须转走。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边老李推车来收
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call while the facility engineer arrives with a cart to collect waste.
shots.narration: 转到集中贮存区，联系安全部门。

shots.scene: 满桶一直堆在实验室，日历翻过很多页，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A full waste container left in the lab while many calendar pages flip by, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一直堆在实验室，就是违规。

shots.scene: 废液桶上贴着一张大标签，分成几栏
shots.prompt_en: A waste container with a large blank label divided into several sections. No people.
shots.narration: 暂存期间，标签要一看就懂。

shots.scene: 小研在标签上逐栏填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in each section of the blank label with a pen.
shots.narration: 写明成分和大致比例。

shots.scene: 标签上的危险象形图和日期栏特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the label showing hazard pictograms and a blank date box. No people.
shots.narration: 还有产生者名称地址和废物代码。

shots.scene: 没贴标签的瓶子图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled bottle icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 容器不能没有标签。

shots.scene: 敞口的废液桶图标打叉，盖紧的桶打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an open waste container crossed out with a red X, and a tightly capped one with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 倒完随手盖紧，不能敞口。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志的废物袋和化学废液桶分开放
shots.prompt_en: A bag with a biohazard warning sign kept separately from a chemical waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 受管制医疗废物，另有一套规矩。

shots.scene: 培养皿、试管、血液样品图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of culture dishes, test tubes and a blood sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 培养物、菌种、血液制品都算。

shots.scene: 废物袋放进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Wearing gloves and a lab coat, the female graduate student places a biohazard bag into an autoclave.
shots.narration: 现场高压灭菌，或送场外焚烧。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白的州规定手册，旁边运输车图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank state rules handbook next to a delivery truck icon.
shots.narration: 运输有专门规定，要懂所在州规定。

shots.scene: 一只硬质锐器盒，带生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A rigid sharps container with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器要放进防刺穿的锐器盒。

shots.scene: 锐器盒侧面一条装量线
shots.prompt_en: A sharps container with a fill line marked on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 装到四分之三就封盒更换。

shots.scene: 装得溢出的锐器盒和手指图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An overfilled sharps container with a finger icon nearby, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 硬塞进去，最容易扎伤手。

shots.scene: 运输车图标带着一张空白联单
shots.prompt_en: A waste truck icon carrying a blank transfer form. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废物运走，要有转移联单。

shots.scene: 实验室、运输车、处置厂三个图标用链条相连
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by a chain: a laboratory, a truck and a disposal plant. No people.
shots.narration: 谁产生、谁运输、谁处置，一清二楚。

shots.scene: 联单从实验室出发，绕一圈回到实验室
shots.prompt_en: A blank form icon traveling from a lab to a truck to a plant and back to the lab in a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 联单签回来，才算闭环。

shots.scene: 老周查看日历上的空白回执记录
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks a blank receipt record against a calendar.
shots.narration: 35天没签回，要调查并上报。

shots.scene: 一条链子从处置厂连回实验室，没有断开
shots.prompt_en: An unbroken chain linking a disposal plant back to the laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 交出去了，责任并没有交出去。

shots.scene: 处置厂图标出现警示，箭头指回实验室
shots.prompt_en: A warning icon appears over a disposal plant with an arrow pointing back to the laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 对方处置不当，产生单位也要担责。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周核对空白资质证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man look over a blank legal document together.
shots.narration: 法律和经济责任，始终都在。

shots.section_title: 从源头到终点都经得起查
shots.scene: 放大镜扫过暂存区、分类桶、联单
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass sweeping over an accumulation area, sorted containers and a blank form. No people.
shots.narration: 暂存不超量，分类不出错。
overlay: 从源头到终点都经得起查

shots.section_title: 从源头到终点都经得起查
shots.scene: 欣欣双手抱胸，认真看着镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot folds its arms and looks seriously at the camera.
shots.narration: 不知道规定，不能成为借口。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分类废液桶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside sorted waste containers.
shots.narration: 分类先看标签，不相容不混。

shots.scene: 贴好标签、盖紧的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A tightly capped waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 标签写全，容器随手盖紧。

shots.scene: 暂存区和转运车图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an accumulation area and a collection cart. No people.
shots.narration: 暂存不超上限，满了3天内转走。

shots.scene: 生物危害袋和锐器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biohazard bag and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物先灭活，锐器盒别装满。

shots.scene: 下水道打叉、联单链条图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chain linked to a blank form. No people.
shots.narration: 联单要闭环，责任永不转移。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的废物暂存区旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy waste accumulation area.
shots.narration: 管好每一滴废液，下次见！
